sections.title: 1. General Provisions
sections.body: These Terms of Use govern your access to and use of the PostShop mobile application. By using the App, you agree to these Terms in full.

sections.title: 2. Description of the Service
sections.body: PostShop is a mobile marketplace that allows buyers to browse products, add them to a cart, and place orders with home delivery or pickup from designated pickup points. Sellers can register shops, list products, and manage orders through the seller platform.

sections.title: 3. Registration and Account
sections.body: Access to certain features requires registration via your phone number. You are responsible for keeping your verification code confidential. You must provide accurate and truthful information. One account is permitted per phone number. You may delete your account at any time via the Profile section.

sections.title: 4. Seller Registration
sections.body: To become a seller, you must submit the required business documents for verification. Seller access is granted only after documents are reviewed and approved by the PostShop team. PostShop reserves the right to reject or revoke seller status if documents are found to be invalid or if the Terms are violated.

sections.title: 5. Orders and Payments
sections.body: By placing an order, you confirm the accuracy of your delivery details. Available payment methods: cash, card, or cash and card. Available delivery methods: home delivery or pickup from a pickup point. You may cancel an order before it has been processed by the seller.

sections.title: 6. User Conduct
sections.body: You agree not to use the App for any fraudulent or illegal activity, post false or misleading content, attempt to gain unauthorized access to other accounts or systems, or use automated tools to interact with the App.

sections.title: 7. Intellectual Property
sections.body: All content in the App — including logos, design, text, and product listings — is the property of PostShop or its respective sellers. You may not copy, reproduce, or distribute this content without written permission.

sections.title: 8. Limitation of Liability
sections.body: PostShop acts as a platform intermediary and is not responsible for the quality or legality of products listed by sellers, disputes between buyers and sellers, or losses caused by technical failures, loss of internet connection, or force majeure.

sections.title: 9. Privacy
sections.body: We collect and process your personal data (name, phone number, address) solely to provide the services described in these Terms. Your data is not shared with third parties except as required to fulfill your orders.

sections.title: 10. Changes to the Terms
sections.body: PostShop reserves the right to update these Terms at any time. Continued use of the App after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated Terms.

sections.title: 1. General Information
sections.body: We collect and process your personal data in order to provide the marketplace services. By using our application, you consent to the collection and processing of your data as described here.

sections.title: 2. Collected Data
sections.body: To register and use the services, we collect your phone number, first name, last name, delivery address, and order history.

sections.title: 3. Purpose of Data Use
sections.body: Your data is used to process orders, execute home deliveries, send notifications about order status, and resolve issues related to customer support.

sections.title: 4. Data Sharing with Third Parties
sections.body: We only share your delivery address and contact information with couriers and sellers strictly for the purpose of delivering your orders. We do not sell your personal data to third parties.

sections.title: 5. Security Measures
sections.body: We use modern encryption protocols and technical security measures to protect your personal data from unauthorized access, modification, or disclosure.

sections.title: 6. User Rights
sections.body: You have the right to request access, correction, or deletion of your personal data. You can delete your profile at any time through the Account settings.
